en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair, seated on a simple wooden bench against a painted backdrop. She wears a folk-style costume with geometric embroidered borders on the skirt and hem, a decorated belt, layered necklaces with a circular central medallion, and a headband of rectangular ornaments. The image has the soft focus and tonal quality typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. No visible writing or caption appears on the front.
